name: io.github.Techssss/tiktok-shop-mcp-server
title: TikTok & TikTok Shop Data MCP Server
description: Public TikTok & TikTok Shop (OEC) data across 22+ countries: videos, VTT transcripts, SKUs & VQScore

tools.name: decode_tiktok_snowflake
tools.description: [FREE - NO API KEY REQUIRED] Decode any 64-bit TikTok or CapCut Snowflake ID (Video, User, Comment, Live Room, Product, Template) into exact UTC creation timestamp, age in days, and datacenter shard.

tools.name: build_tiktok_shop_deeplink
tools.description: [FREE - NO API KEY REQUIRED] Generate 16 native mobile app deep-links (aweme://ec/ & snssdk1180://ec/), storefront #1 product pinning links, and type:35 video cart anchor JSON across 22+ countries.

region.description: ISO-2 country code (US, UK, VN, ID, TH, BR, MY, PH, SG, JP)

tools.name: analyze_short_video_hook_and_beats
tools.description: [FREE - NO API KEY REQUIRED] Score a short-video script or caption for 3-second retention hooks (0-100) and generate a BPM beat-synced auto-cut timeline.

script_text.description: Opening hook, transcript, or caption text

bpm.description: Audio tempo in Beats Per Minute

tools.name: get_tiktok_video_intelligence
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Fetch full TikTok video metadata, VQScore algorithm quality, LUFS audio loudness, Whisper VTT subtitles, pinned TikTok Shop products, CapCut anchors, and no-watermark HD MP4.

url.description: Full TikTok video URL or video_id

rapidapi_key.description: Optional X-RapidAPI-Key (or pass via X-RapidAPI-Key header)

tools.name: get_tiktok_creator_profile_and_analytics
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Fetch TikTok creator profile, follower/heart totals, engagement rate %, sponsorship USD valuation, bio email lead, and recent posts.

tools.name: get_tiktok_video_comments_and_replies
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Retrieve viewer comments, commenter region, and nested replies on any TikTok video.

tools.name: get_tiktok_trending_and_search
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Discover real-time trending TikTok videos, 922 national hot keywords with ByteDance TextNet taxonomy IDs, and search autocomplete suggestions.

region.description: Country code (US, UK, VN, ID, TH, BR, JP, DE)

keyword.description: Optional search keyword for autocomplete suggestions

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_product_and_seller
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Extract TikTok Shop product detail (SKUs, stock, 16+ studio origin-jpeg images, 34 copywriting desc_blocks), seller store rating, or vt.tiktok.com affiliate link forensics.

url.description: TikTok Shop product URL or vt.tiktok.com shortlink

region.description: Country code (VN, ID, TH, US, UK, MY, PH, SG, BR)

tools.name: get_tiktok_transcript_and_translate
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Extract 0.2s Whisper ASR WebVTT subtitles/transcripts from a TikTok video or translate time-synced subtitles via ByteDance AI Lab glide_v3_2 LLM.

target_lang.description: Target language code (en, vi, es, id, th, ja)

tools.name: get_tiktok_commercial_music_and_capcut_templates
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Fetch commercial-cleared TikTok music tracks with exact millisecond StrongBeat drum onset arrays for FFmpeg auto-editing.

region.description: Country code (US, VN, UK, ID, TH, BR, JP)

tools.name: get_tiktok_live_room_intelligence
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Check live room broadcast status, totalEnters count, direct FLV/HLS/Audio-Only stream URLs, or regional live categories and 1.4MB gift catalogs.

region.description: Country code (US, VN, ID, TH, UK, BR)

room_ids.description: Optional comma-separated room_ids to check alive status

tools.name: search_tiktok_videos_by_keyword
tools.description: [GLOBAL CLOUD - 22+ REGIONS] Search TikTok videos by keyword across 22+ countries with no-watermark MP4 links and 64-bit Snowflake viral velocity (views_per_hour) scoring.

keyword.description: Search keyword (e.g. 'kem chống nắng', 'tiktok shop finds')

region.description: Country code (VN, US, ID, TH, BR, GB)

tools.name: get_tiktok_shop_video_factory_pack
tools.description: [AI VIDEO FACTORY - TOOL 1] Generate a complete 1-click TikTok Shop review video production package: 20+ uncompressed studio origin-jpeg images, 5-part voiceover script from 34 copywriting desc_blocks, commercial music with StrongBeat scene cut timeline, type:35 cart anchor JSON, and Storefront #1 product pin deeplink.

url.description: TikTok Shop product URL, vt.tiktok.com shortlink, or product_id

region.description: Country code (VN, US, ID, TH, BR)

tools.name: harvest_kol_shop_affiliate_products
tools.description: [KALODATA / FASTMOSS CLONE] Scan any KOL, KOC, or competitor @username's latest videos to harvest all pinned TikTok Shop products (type:35), rank Hero Products by promotion frequency, and extract all Whisper ASR .vtt sales scripts and VQScores.

username.description: TikTok creator or shop username without @ (e.g. 'hasaki.vn')

limit.description: Number of latest videos to scan (1-11)

region.description: Country code (VN, US, ID, TH, BR)

tools.name: audit_tiktok_video_algorithm_vqscore
tools.description: [ALGORITHM VQSCORE & C2PA AUDITOR] Audit any TikTok video's hidden internal VQScore (0-100 FYP threshold >=65), audio loudness LUFS, hourly viral velocity, Duet/Stitch permissions, and get the anti-recode / anti-C2PA FFmpeg encoding recipe.

region.description: Country code (VN, US, ID, TH, BR)
